title: A hare’s horn
explanation: The expression names something impossible or unreal. Its force comes from looking for a feature the animal does not possess.
meaning_odia: ଠେକୁଆର ଶିଙ୍ଗ ନଥାଏ; ସେହି ନଥିବା ଜିନିଷକୁ ଖୋଜିବାର ଚିତ୍ରରେ ଅସମ୍ଭବତା ବୁଝାଯାଏ। ବାସ୍ତବରେ ନଥିବା କିଛିକୁ ଥିବା ପରି କହିଲେ ବା ଖୋଜିଲେ ଏହି ରୂଢ଼ି ଖାପ ଖାଏ। ସାଧାରଣ ଏକ ଛବି ଦେଇ ଅବାସ୍ତବ ଦାବିକୁ ସଂକ୍ଷେପରେ ଚିହ୍ନାଇବା ଏହାର ଶକ୍ତି।
usage_example: Someone asks for a plan with unlimited benefits and no cost or trade-off. (Original editorial example, not a collected quotation.)
cultural_context: The dictionary explicitly explains figurative use and lists related impossible images. It is semantically related to existing ଆକାଶକୁସୁମ, but has a distinct image and wording.
